angre.summary: I worked on art direction and motion design for Prachyam’s film on Kanhoji Angre, with character scenes, coastal maps and naval sequences.
angre.desc: Character scenes, coastal maps and naval motion design for Prachyam.
angre.body: Prachyam’s film follows Kanhoji Angre and his role in Maratha naval history. This selection brings together my character scenes, coastal maps and naval sequences.
angre.detail: My work covered creative direction, visual design and motion treatment across the selected sequences. The accompanying showcase includes Sambhaji Maharaj, Maharani Tarabai and Kanhoji Angre, alongside scenes of the naval fleets.
angre.context: Prachyam · Kanhoji Angre · Selected motion work
contribution: Handled creative direction and visual design for the selected work.
Worked on composition and motion treatment across character, map and naval sequences.
angre.title: Kanhoji Angre

bhabha.summary: I created 1960s-inspired graphics and motion for Prachyam’s Who Killed Bhabha?
bhabha.desc: 1960s-inspired graphics for a documentary on Homi Bhabha.
bhabha.body: Prachyam’s film looks at Homi Bhabha’s contribution to Indian nuclear science and the circumstances of his death. I worked on the graphics and motion design, bringing archival images, documents and scientific references into the sequences shown here.
bhabha.detail: I used typography, texture and compositing to connect the archival material. The 1960s-inspired treatment gave portraits, records and institutional scenes a consistent visual style.
contribution: Created 1960s-inspired graphics and motion design for the documentary.
Composed archival imagery, documents and typography for the sequences shown here.

story.challenge: Prachyam’s Who Killed Bhabha? looks at the scientist’s life and death. My brief was to give its archival photographs, documents and scientific references a consistent period treatment.
decisions: Use a 1960s-inspired graphic treatment to place the sequences in the period.
Connect material from different sources with consistent typography and texture.
Build sequences around portraits, institutions and records, including the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research.
story.result: The work became part of the documentary released on Prachyam OTT. This selection brings together my graphics and motion sequences for the film.

brochure.summary: I designed Prachyam’s brochure, bringing its story into print through cultural collages, typography and editorial layouts.
brochure.desc: Prachyam’s story, told through illustrated spreads and typography.
brochure.body: I designed a brochure introducing Prachyam and the ideas behind its work. English and Devanagari typography sit alongside cultural collages and an illustrated timeline, with orange accents and recurring page details connecting the spreads.
brochure.detail: I paired large collages and an illustrated timeline with quieter areas for text. Warm orange accents, fine rules and recurring page details connect the spreads.
contribution: Designed the cover and interior editorial layouts.
Combined cultural imagery, illustration and typography to carry the brand’s story across the brochure.

cultural-motion.summary: A few more motion sequences I created at Prachyam, from illustrated portraits to devotional scenes and cultural practices.
cultural-motion.desc: Illustrated portraits, devotional scenes and cultural motion work.
cultural-motion.body: This selection includes a cave meditation scene, a guru portrait, kirtan, Krishna and Rukmini, and an Upanayan sequence.
cultural-motion.detail: I worked on creative direction, visual design and motion treatment across these selected scenes.
contribution: Handled creative direction and visual design for the selected work.
Worked on composition and motion treatment across the illustrated scenes.
cultural-motion.title: Other highlights from Prachyam

daulat.summary: I designed Daulat’s website to introduce its wealth-management approach and guide visitors towards a consultation.
daulat.desc: I designed a wealth-management website with engraved illustrations and clear paths to consultation.
daulat.body: I translated Daulat’s brief into website layouts, typography and imagery. Green and gold illustrations and an editorial type treatment carry the design across desktop and mobile.
daulat.detail: The design pairs Playfair Display with botanical and financial illustrations. I used a clear page hierarchy to introduce the firm’s approach, explain its services and lead visitors to a conversation.
contribution: Designed the website layouts and responsive presentation.
Developed the typography, imagery and page hierarchy around Daulat’s positioning and consultation journey.

story.challenge: I needed to express the founder’s vision of wealth as confidence and freedom while making the firm’s offering easy to understand.
decisions: I used green and gold engravings, botanical forms and financial imagery to give the website a consistent visual language.
I paired Playfair Display with a clear hierarchy of headings and supporting text to organise the story.
I adapted the design for mobile and kept the consultation action prominent.
story.result: I produced a website design with a consistent visual language across desktop and mobile, from the opening message to the consultation prompt.

ecolab.summary: I handled visual design for Ecolab’s films, event screens and internal showcases, including Spark Growth and RELIGHT.
ecolab.desc: Event films, campaign visuals and internal showcases for Ecolab.
ecolab.body: My work at Ecolab ranged from event screens in Egypt to an internal year-in-review showcase. I handled visual design and design direction for the selected work, adapting the brand’s blue palette, typography and motion to each format.
ecolab.detail: This selection includes Spark Growth, RELIGHT and sales campaign visuals alongside internal communications. The gallery combines original project material with clearly labelled portfolio refreshes.
ecolab.context: In-house work · Senior Marketing Visual Designer at Ecolab
contribution: Handled visual design and design direction for the work presented.
Adapted Ecolab’s visual language for event screens, campaign films and internal showcases.

story.challenge: I needed to give event films, sales communications and internal showcases their own character while keeping them recognisably Ecolab.
decisions: I used Ecolab blue and consistent typography to connect pieces with very different themes.
I used motion to structure information and give key messages emphasis across the films.
I adapted each visual treatment to its setting, from event screens to an internal year-in-review showcase.
story.result: I created a selection of films, campaign visuals and event-screen work, including Spark Growth and RELIGHT, during my time at Ecolab.

ikea.summary: I explored human craft in an independent IKEA campaign concept, using hands, shadows and close-up workshop imagery.
ikea.desc: An independent campaign concept about human craft in the age of AI.
ikea.body: I put the maker’s hands at the centre of the campaign, drawing attention to the care behind everyday objects. This was an independent concept, not commissioned by IKEA.
ikea.detail: Dramatic light and close-up craft imagery carry the idea through posters and film. Blue-and-yellow illustrations translate gestures such as measuring, sanding and assembling into a supporting graphic system.
ikea.context: Independent concept campaign · not commissioned by IKEA
contribution: Developed the campaign idea and visual direction.
Created poster concepts, a supporting illustration system and social applications.
captions: Independent concept brief — not commissioned by IKEA

indentured.summary: I created motion sequences for Prachyam’s Chained Souls: Girmitiya, using maps, archival material and typography.
indentured.desc: I used maps, archive and motion to tell a history of indentured labour.
indentured.body: For Chained Souls: Girmitiya, I developed the visual direction and motion treatment for the sequences shown here. The work moves between scenes of workers, a map connecting India and Mauritius, historical material and typography.
indentured.detail: I brought together geographic movement, archival documents and scenes of working life through composition, typography and animation.
contribution: Led creative direction and visual design for the selected sequences.
Developed the composition, typography and motion treatment across maps, historical material and human scenes.
indentured.title: Chained Souls: Girmitiya

indiclass.summary: I developed the opening identity and motion-design styleframes for Prachyam’s Indiclass series.
indiclass.desc: I designed an opening identity for Prachyam’s Indiclass series.
indiclass.body: I explored logo directions and developed the title treatment for Indiclass, Prachyam’s series on Indian culture and knowledge. The styleframes bring together cultural imagery and light as a symbol of learning.
indiclass.detail: My work spans logo exploration, the final title design, styleframes and motion direction for the series opening.
contribution: Led the visual direction, from logo exploration to the final title treatment.
Created styleframes using Indian art, cultural imagery and light as a symbol of knowledge.
Developed the motion direction for the opening identity.

lachit.summary: I led the visual treatment and motion design for Prachyam’s film on Lachit Borphukan, working within a twelve-day schedule.
lachit.desc: Visual treatment, animated panels and custom maps for Prachyam.
lachit.body: Prachyam’s film follows Lachit Borphukan, an Ahom commander associated with the Battle of Saraighat. My work covered the visual treatment and motion design for its panels.
lachit.detail: I used Midjourney and Photoshop’s generative fill for most panels, and designed the maps myself. The project ran for twelve days.
contribution: Led the visual treatment and motion design for the panels.
Created AI-assisted imagery and custom map panels.

story.challenge: Prachyam’s film follows Lachit Borphukan, the Ahom commander associated with the Battle of Saraighat. I had twelve days to develop the visual treatment and motion design for my part of the film.
decisions: Use Midjourney and Photoshop’s generative fill to create most panels.
I designed custom map panels to make the geography easier to follow.
Carry the visual treatment through each panel’s motion design.
story.result: The completed work is documented in my film showreel and selected frames.

phyllo.summary: I designed Phyllo Wrapped 2024, creator-search promotions and brand-safety graphics for Phyllo and insightIQ.
phyllo.desc: Social graphics for API milestones, creator discovery and brand safety.
phyllo.body: At Phyllo, I turned product messages into social graphics for Phyllo and insightIQ. The work included a Wrapped 2024 recap, API milestones, LinkedIn creator-search promotion and brand-safety communication.
phyllo.detail: I used illustrated scenes, feature callouts and prominent numbers to explain what the products did. Phyllo’s dark blue and insightIQ’s lime-and-purple treatments gave each set of posts a distinct identity.
phyllo.context: In-house work · Visual Designer at Phyllo
contribution: Designed the Wrapped recap, product-feature posts and creator-marketing graphics.
Used illustration, feature callouts and distinct colour treatments for Phyllo and insightIQ.

sahebs.summary: I worked on the poster, social artwork and trailer for Prachyam’s Sahebs Who Never Left.
sahebs.desc: Poster, social artwork and trailer work for a Prachyam documentary.
sahebs.body: Sahebs Who Never Left presents Prachyam’s argument about colonial influence and Indian history. My work here covers the film’s poster, social campaign and trailer.
sahebs.detail: I used historical portraits, layered collage and bold typography across the campaign, with red, black and paper textures tying the pieces together.
contribution: Creative direction and visual design for the selected campaign work.
Composition, typography and motion treatment across the poster, social artwork and trailer.

sanskrit.summary: I created motion sequences for Prachyam’s Gauri Mahulikar on Sanskrit, combining script details, explanatory typography, maps and illustrations.
sanskrit.desc: Scripts, language maps and illustrated traditions in motion.
sanskrit.body: I led creative direction and visual design for the selected sequences from Gauri Mahulikar on Sanskrit. The work moves between close studies of script, typographic explanations and illustrated scenes.
sanskrit.detail: The selection covers Brahmi script, Shruti and Smruti, language families, and Shiv and Shakti. I developed the composition, typography and motion treatment across these pieces.
sanskrit.context: Prachyam · Indiclass · Gauri Mahulikar on Sanskrit
contribution: Led creative direction and hands-on visual design for the selected sequences.
Developed composition, typography and motion treatments for script details, explanations, maps and illustrations.
sanskrit.title: Gauri Mahulikar on Sanskrit

solace.summary: I created Solace as a self-initiated AI wellness concept, shaping its product direction, identity and website.
solace.desc: Product concept, visual identity and website for an imagined AI wellness companion.
solace.body: I wanted to explore how an AI companion could feel quieter and more approachable. For Solace, I developed the product concept alongside a visual identity built from a simple three-part symbol, cyan accents and soft, atmospheric imagery.
solace.detail: I carried that direction into desktop and mobile website presentations, typographic posters and social applications. Dark landscape imagery and warm neutral backgrounds give the bright cyan elements room to stand out.
contribution: Owned the concept and set the product and visual direction.
Designed the identity, colour palette and brand applications.
Designed website presentations for desktop and mobile.

solaris.summary: I developed a fintech identity concept for Solaris around a sunburst mark, warm colour and imagery inspired by light.
solaris.desc: A fintech brand concept spanning identity, campaign imagery and communication layouts.
solaris.body: For Solaris, I explored the visual language of light: a sunburst symbol, orange landscapes and tactile materials. I carried the identity across social layouts, brand cards, staff passes, an app-icon mockup and a billboard concept.
solaris.detail: I carried the identity across social layouts, brand cards, staff passes, an app-icon mockup and a billboard concept. The work moves between expressive campaign imagery and simpler white layouts for financial messaging.
contribution: Developed the brand mark, colour direction and typography treatments.
Created a visual direction built around sunlight, glowing forms and dimensional materials.
Explored the identity across campaign, print and digital mockups.

vibe.summary: I created The Vibe Collective as a personal lifestyle-brand concept, exploring logo variations, motion and apparel mockups.
vibe.desc: A lifestyle identity concept across clothing, bags and motion.
vibe.body: I explored a flexible identity using bold lettering, peace signs and smileys. The system carries across garments, tote bags and campaign imagery.
vibe.detail: Logo variations and animation explore how the identity can change between formats. Apparel and bag mockups show the marks at different sizes and on fabric.
contribution: Developed the identity, symbols and logo variations.
Created logo animations and apparel, bag and campaign mockups.

vistara.summary: I designed Studio Vistara’s identity and explored it across signage, print, website layouts and motion.
vistara.desc: A geometric identity for an architecture studio.
vistara.body: I built the identity around a line-drawn architectural mark, then carried it into print and digital applications.
vistara.detail: The presentation brings together signage, business cards, posters and website mockups. A 3D animation explores the mark through depth and movement.
vistara.context: Brand identity for an architecture studio
contribution: Designed the logo and visual identity.
Developed signage, print and digital applications.
Extended the mark into a 3D animation.

story.challenge: Create an identity that connects with architecture and works across physical and digital formats.
decisions: I used a geometric line-drawn mark to reference architectural structure.
I paired the mark with clear typography across signage, print and website mockups.
I explored the mark in 3D to bring depth and movement to the identity.
story.result: An identity system presented across signage, print, website mockups and an animated logo.

wootz.summary: I created titles, maps and historical motion sequences for Prachyam’s Wootz Steel documentary.
wootz.desc: Titles, maps and illustrated scenes for a documentary on Wootz steel.
wootz.body: Wootz Steel is a short documentary in Prachyam’s Gifts of India collection, exploring the history and craft of steelmaking. I led the creative direction and visual design of the selected motion work shown here.
wootz.detail: My work spans the title treatment, geographic sequences and illustrated historical environments, with composition, typography and motion treatment across these pieces.
wootz.context: Prachyam · Gifts of India · Selected motion work
contribution: Led creative direction and hands-on visual design for the selected sequences.
Developed composition, typography and motion treatments across titles, maps and historical scenes.
